title: A 27B Model Now Runs On An iPhone. Here's The Whole Local AI Ladder
description:
Two weeks ago a 27 billion parameter model started running on an iPhone. Nobody added memory to that phone, and nobody added memory to your graphics card either.

Four compression tricks landed in the last six months, and each one hands you capability you never paid for in VRAM. This is where every one of them lands, sorted by the only spec that decides what you can actually run at home.

⏱️ CHAPTERS 
00:00 - A 27B model on a phone 
00:48 - Find your VRAM number
01:08 - Trick 1: run the same layers twice (4 to 8 GB) 
02:50 - Trick 2: shrink the bits, not the model (8 to 24 GB) 
05:11 - Trick 3: stop the model rambling (24 to 96 GB) 
07:03 - Trick 4: only wake the experts you need (96 to 192 GB) 
09:19 - The top rung, and the licensing trap 
11:30 - The honest ceiling: where local still loses 
12:00 - How to pick yours
